headline: Apple sells $50 packs for extra AI feature usage
summary: Apple has updated Logic Pro with a one-time $49.99 'Buy More Usage' option that extends access to its built-in AI assistant after a user hits the monthly usage limit for some Apple Intelligence features.

claims.statement: Apple updated Logic Pro with a one-time $49.99 'Buy More Usage' option after previously outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features.

sources.quote: After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to "Buy More Usage" for a one-time purchase price of $49.99
Apple starts offering $50 extended usage packs for AI features in Creator Studio

claims.statement: The extended usage pack is needed once a user reaches the monthly limit for Logic Pro's built-in AI assistant.

sources.quote: It'll cost you to access Logic Pro's AI assistant after you reach the monthly usage limit.
